queries.name: Q1 Look up one customer's orders
queries.good: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.status, o.total_amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.email = ?
plan_good: SEARCH c USING COVERING INDEX ux_customers_email (email=?)

queries.name: Q2 Revenue for calendar year 2024
queries.bad: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(unit_price*quantity) FROM orders_flat WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024'
queries.good: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01'
plan_good: SEARCH orders USING COVERING INDEX ix_orders_date_amt (order_date>? AND order_date<?)

queries.name: Q3 Top 10 customers by spend
queries.bad: SELECT customer_email, SUM(unit_price*quantity) s FROM orders_flat GROUP BY customer_email ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 10
queries.good: SELECT customer_id, SUM(total_amount) s FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 10
plan_bad: USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
plan_good: SCAN orders USING COVERING INDEX ix_orders_customer
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

queries.name: Q4 Deep pagination (page 2,500)
queries.bad: SELECT * FROM orders_flat ORDER BY order_date DESC, row_id DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 50000
queries.good: SELECT order_id, order_date, status FROM orders WHERE (order_date, order_id) < (?, ?) ORDER BY order_date DESC, order_id DESC LIMIT 20
plan_bad: USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
